text:
alex: noticing a spike of gpu_exporter_missing alerts in us-west-2, dashboards show per-device metrics at 0 for several pods :eyes:

sara: same. dcgm sidecar is CrashLoopBackOff on startup for a subset of nodes, looks like init-time failures (~2m window).

jordan: quick grab from logs: `dcgm-exporter init: waiting for /var/run/nvidia` then `failed to create socket: address already in use` — init container and main exporter probably racing to bind the same unix socket.

lee: we added an early nvidia-modprobe init last week; could be interacting with node-exporter or a leftover socket from kubelet volume mount.

ops-bot: prometheus alert gpu_exporter_missing fired for 5 nodes — incident created INC-2026-184 :rotating_light:

sara: short-term mitigations: make init container only create dirs and perms, don't bind sockets; or change exporter to use per-pod socket suffix to avoid collision. Also consider livenessProbe delay to avoid flapping.

alex: can we do a hotfix helm/daemonset env override to give unique socket path? something like SOCKET_PATH=/var/run/dcgm-${POD_NAME}.sock

alex: ```
kubectl -n infra set env daemonset/gpu-exporter SOCKET_PATH=/var/run/dcgm-$(POD_NAME).sock
kubectl rollout restart daemonset/gpu-exporter
```

sara: rolling to gpu-canary pool now (node-pool:gpu-canary) :thumbsup:

jordan: note on Prometheus: restarting exporter won't magically backfill old scrapes — if series went to 0 and now return, dashboards will show gaps. We should avoid noise by tuning the alert to require 10m missing and exclude gpu-canary during canary. Also consider recording rules to keep aggregate device counts so transient zeros don't trigger SLO noise.

lee: agreed on alert tuning. Proposed alert change: `for: 10m` and add `node_pool != "gpu-canary"` label guard. Also add a short startup grace period in livenessProbe (initialDelaySeconds: 30).

sara: will open two PRs: 1) helm values change to set SOCKET_PATH and livenessProbe tweaks, 2) prometheus alert rule change to 10m + label exclusion. I'll link PRs here once created.

alex: thanks. after canary (targeting 30m watch) we'll decide full rollout — plan for full us-west-2 rollout tomorrow 01:00 UTC if stable.

ops-bot: events: daemonset/gpu-exporter restarted on gpu-canary-1,gpu-canary-2 (restarts: 2)

jordan: one more operational note — we should add a small startup metric (metric: dcgm_exporter_ready{pod}) emitted only after bind successful. That will make alerting and runbook simpler than relying on raw device series presence.

alex: good idea. add to backlog if PR scope is getting big, but prefer a quick fix + alert tune now. Documenting steps in INC-2026-184.

sara: will update incident and post PR links here. thanks all :)
